subject: Digital Electronics
questionText:
Which of the following is true about decoding error
in asynchronous counter?
(a)
It is removed by using additional signaling
(b) It can be avoided using strobe signal
(c)
Decoding error is present in asynchronous as
well as in synchronous counter
(d) None of these
[NAT]

options.text: It is removed by using additional signaling
It can be avoided using strobe signal
Decoding error is present in asynchronous as

explanation: Practice Question from Digital Electronics DPP-11 (Sequential Circuits (Part - 4)).
